benchmark.schemaSql: CREATE TABLE orders (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, total INTEGER NOT NULL); CREATE INDEX idx_orders_customer_id ON orders(customer_id);

columns.name: status
columns.expression: CASE WHEN row_number % 4 IN (0, 1) THEN 'paid' WHEN row_number % 4 = 2 THEN 'canceled' ELSE 'pending' END

title: [パフォーマンスチューニング][書いてみよう] 条件付き集計で何度も読まない
statement:
orders テーブルから、顧客ごとの paid 注文数、canceled 注文数、paid 注文の合計金額を求めてください。表示する列は customer_id, paid_count, canceled_count, paid_total。paid 注文がある顧客だけを、paid_total の降順、customer_id の昇順で並べます。

orders は1回だけ読み、CASE WHEN を使った条件付き集計で3つの値をまとめて計算します。

constraints.name: 条件付き集計
constraints.value: CASE WHEN を使って status ごとの件数と合計を1回の集計で求めます

constraints.name: 対象顧客
constraints.value: paid_count が1以上の顧客だけを表示します

starterSql:
SELECT
  customer_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paid_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'canceled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS canceled_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN total ELSE 0 END) AS paid_total
FROM orders
GROUP BY customer_id
-- paid_count が1以上の顧客だけにします
ORDER BY paid_total DESC, customer_id ASC;
solutionSql:
SELECT
  customer_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paid_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'canceled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS canceled_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN total ELSE 0 END) AS paid_total
FROM orders
GROUP BY customer_id
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 1
ORDER BY paid_total DESC, customer_id ASC;
